**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The Agreement imposes no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant on Mortgage Logic.com. I checked every plausible location:

- **§ 8 (Client covenants)** — compliance with laws, notification, limitation on access, Credit Data licence, Client Content reps, spamming. No hiring/solicitation restriction.
- **§ 10 (Confidentiality)** — no tail non-solicit; obligations are limited to Proprietary Information and Derivative Documentation.
- **§§ 12–30 (indemnity and general provisions)** — no restrictive covenant; "employees" appears only in the indemnity beneficiary lists and the § 8(c) access restriction.
- Targeted searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "hire", "induce … to leave", "personnel" and "directly or indirectly" surfaced only § 7 (unsolicited commercial e-mail), which is unrelated.

Because there is no restriction on the Client at all, the Agreement meets the preferred position and no redline was proposed. One note for the file: § 8(d) refers to a separate "Non-Competition Agreement" governing Credit Data use — if that side agreement contains a personnel non-solicit or no-hire, it should be reviewed under this rule separately, but nothing in this document creates one.
